The lab reference in three pages. Page titles map to the repository
document [docs/ai-sec-implementation.md](https://github.com/shsingh/ai-sec-lab/blob/main/docs/ai-sec-implementation.md),
which holds the same text for in-repo reading.

- [What](what.qmd) — the system and its proof: components, request path,
  claims, planes mapping.
- [Why](why.qmd) — design rationale for every dependency, plus known
  limits.
- [How](how.qmd) — the per-cell walkthrough of all six notebooks with
  their code, plus the operating model and the three commands.
